subunit: Homodimer of lamin A and lamin C. Lamin dimers then assemble into dimeric head-to-tail polymers. Ultimately, two head-to-tail polymers assemble laterally into a protofilament with a uniformly shaped rod of 3.5 nm in diameter. Interacts with lamin-associated polypeptides IA, IB and TMPO-alpha, RB1 and with emerin. Interacts with SREBF1, SREBF2, SUN2 and TMEM43. Interacts with TMEM201. Proteolytically processed isoform A interacts with NARF. Interacts with SUN1. Interacts with MLIP. Interacts with DMPK; may regulate nuclear envelope stability. Interacts with SUV39H1; the interaction increases stability of SUV39H1. Interacts with SYNE2. Interacts with ITSN1 isoform 2. Interacts with IFFO1; enables the formation of an interior nucleoskeleton that is recruited to DNA double-strand breaks
